sections.title: Employment Contract
sections.text:
S.E.E.S. member Koromaru is waiting for you to return.

Don't keep him waiting too long.

sections.title: Student Overview
sections.text:
Koromaru. Companion of Makoto Yuki, a student of this class; recognized unanimously by the class and specially registered as an honorary class member.
According to his companions, Koromaru is Perro kin. Locals in Laterano rarely encounter kin willing to spend so much time in human company, and Koromaru's intelligence and considerate nature have left a deep impression on many students and teachers. Aigis in particular shares a close bond with him: she can understand the meaning of his barks and helps him communicate with others. Koromaru thus fitted into the class quickly, and showed an interest in board games. He watched a friendly class match with great enthusiasm and earned the title of "Koromaru, Bringer of Victory."

sections.text:
Contrast imaging shows that the outlines of Koromaru's internal organs are clear, with no abnormal shadows. Testing for Originium particles in the circulatory system likewise revealed no abnormality and no sign of Oripathy infection; at this stage he can be confirmed as non-infected.

sections.title: Archive File 1
sections.text:
In the contest over Koromaru's hours at school, our class won an indisputable victory—a line worth writing into the class chronicle.
Our class's rival is a class in the elementary division of Saint Marcel Comprehensive School—the one attended by Ken Amada. The representative of that class argues that the elementary division is where Amada and Koromaru first enrolled, and that although Koromaru never formally registered, in principle he should count as a member of the elementary division. Therefore, of Koromaru's five school days a week, three should belong to them. Our class representative countered that the middle division has a higher proportion of outdoor classes and a markedly larger area of free-activity space, and that for the sake of Koromaru's physical and mental well-being, the middle division is better suited to his activities.
With neither side yielding, the dispute gradually slid into a war of honor between the elementary and middle divisions—until Koromaru himself stepped in and ended the mess. With Aigis's help, Koromaru indicated that he wished to spend Mondays, Wednesdays, and Fridays with the middle division, and Tuesdays and Thursdays with the elementary division. The elementary class representative burst into tears from sheer emotion; fortunately Koromaru went to him at once and nestled at his side to soothe him, sparing us the birth of a rumor that "our class bullies elementary schoolers." Let us all thank Koromaru.

*One of the notes stuck to this page: But sir, Koromaru spends all of Friday in your office. Shouldn't we mention that?
*The second note stuck to this page: This is a promise between Koromaru and me. Never mind—it does not affect our class's victory.

sections.title: Encrypted Report
sections.text:
Even the members of S.E.E.S. themselves cannot explain it, but Koromaru does indeed possess the ability to summon a "Persona," and is an important combat asset for the group. Beyond that, Koromaru is, here, essentially... a clever and friendly Perro kin. Old friend, I know you may have questions. Of course Koromaru differs from kin in some respects, but this truly is the "identity" that suits him best. We should count ourselves fortunate that the place they came to was Laterano, and not Bolívar.
As for whether he will stay, there is of course nothing to worry about: Koromaru will move with the other S.E.E.S. members, and he has no motive whatsoever to remain in Laterano. The students here are quite fond of him, but they are still children, and there is a certain "chasing after novelty" in how they treat him. So I promised Koromaru that he may come to my office to rest whenever he needs to. There is, admittedly, a little selfishness in that—I enjoy his company too. It is a kind of... rare familiarity. Perhaps he feels the same? I have never asked.
Spending time with Koromaru, I have gradually come to notice that he seems to take the matter of "parting" somewhat to heart. And in the end, we too will say goodbye... Still, he has his own companions at his side, so it should not grieve him too badly. I hope so, at least.
